claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.item_spell_override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation chassis can represent charges, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction, but grant_spell_access can only point at a spell id plus cast mode. This wand modifies the accessed spells with item-defined parameters that are not the base spell definitions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save DC 15) on the following table from it. Command ("flee" or "grovel" only). Fear (60-foot Cone).
